The three shards finish and upload evidence, or the owner has approved a coverage or runner change.
context:
Evidence: release-v2 run 40971306663, jobs 'UAT stage 1 polars-df' (ends with SweepCancelled: SIGTERM at 23:46 UTC), 'UAT stage 1 pandas-df' and 'UAT stage 1 datafusion-df'. No release-uat artifacts exist for these shards.

Revalidated 2026-10-30 (read-only). The logs for all three shards are available (686 lines each). Each ends with 'The runner has received a shutdown signal' followed by SweepCancelled: SIGTERM raised in run_cell; pandas-df and datafusion-df also carry the annotation 'The hosted runner lost communication with the server ... starves it for CPU/Memory'. The shutdowns came 23.8 (datafusion-df), 25.6 (pandas-df) and 34 (polars-df) minutes into the sweep step. The logs name no cell. Preflight showed 83.54 GiB free, which rules out disk. PR #3760 (merged 2026-10-30 13:48 UTC) kills any cell whose process tree exceeds 13 GiB and records '# UAT_PEAK_RSS_GIB'; no release-v2 run has exercised it yet. Rerunning the failed jobs of run 40971306663 continues to the TestPyPI publish of 0.5.0rc2 if every stage passes. Owner decision 2026-10-30: the release agent session handles the rerun.

Hosted trunk UAT run https://github.com/BenchBox-dev/BenchBox/actions/runs/42536258036 completed with failure at source 2d796acd59be06ab4b4a1742dda84cff419202b9. All selected cells passed for polars-df (45), pandas-df (42), datafusion-df (42) and dask-df (31); none of these current shards ended in a runner shutdown. Counts cover the selected current matrix only; no historical issue is closed by this note. The full run is still red (702/710 passed), so this is not release certification.

Review 2026-11-11: polars-df, pandas-df and datafusion-df shards finished and uploaded in both green runs, with per-cell peak RSS recorded (PR #3760). Open line: no measured root cause ties the rc2 shutdowns to a cell. Related: run 42718296767 attempt 1 hit a pandas-df write_primitives SF1 SIGSEGV (tracked in pandas-df-write-primitives-sf1-segfault).
description: In run 40971306663 the polars-df, pandas-df and datafusion-df shards ended 25-35 minutes into make uat-sweep with 'The runner has received a shutdown signal'. No shard artifact was uploaded and the pandas-df and datafusion-df job logs are unavailable, so the failing cell is unknown. The likely cause, not confirmed, is memory exhaustion at SF1 on the 16 GB hosted runner. Reproduce each shard's cell order, measure peak memory per cell, and either bring the cells within the runner or take an envelope or runner-size change to the owner (paid or larger runners need owner approval).
